description:
[Interviews] Create a role-play persona: an avatar that plays a defined role in a free-form conversation instead of a scored Q&A interview. `portal` selects between two different products: `portal="interview"` builds a SIMULATED PERSONA a recruiter invites candidates to — scored, billed to merchant credits, and listed with the recruiter's other results; `portal="coaching"` (THE DEFAULT) builds a coaching persona learners start themselves from the catalogue, paid per second from their own coaching minutes and never visible to recruiters. Hiring, screening and assessment use `portal="interview"`. `persona_role_avatar`/`persona_role_user` set the roles and `opening_line` the avatar's first spoken line (default: a generic 'Hello'). Full-session recording (recording_full_session) and a longer max_duration raise the credit cost.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

candidate_expectations.description: Mentee assessment goals — free-text describing what the candidate is expected to achieve (max 2100 chars).

candidate_video_introduction.description: Whether a candidate video introduction is optional or required.

code.description: Optional external code/reference for the persona.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

description.description: Short persona description shown to the candidate on the pre-session poster. Unlike create_interview, personas run no AI generation, so this is never auto-generated: null or blank, the poster shows no description; a value frames the scene.

environment.description: Which of your webhook environments results from this interview are delivered to. Defaults to production. Values: `production`: Live hiring | `uat`: User-acceptance testing - an isolated environment for pre-release verification | `development`: Development/testing | `demo`: Demonstrations and sales trials.

interview_attempts.description: Allowed candidate attempts (1-20), defaulting to 3. Only meaningful when `portal` is `interview`; coaching personas are unlimited.

interview_conversation_speed.description: Conversation pace of the AI avatar. Omit/null keeps the template default pace. Values: `slower`: The avatar speaks more slowly | `normal`: Default speaking pace | `faster`: The avatar speaks more quickly for a snappier conversation | `fluent`: Talking pace: the avatar answers 300 ms after the candidate stops speaking.

interview_location.description: Optional location label shown for the session.

interview_template_id.description: Id of the interview template (avatar) the persona uses.

is_embedded.description: Set true when the persona will be embedded as an iframe on an external page. A signed coaching embed (name, email, signature) signs the visitor in as a learner of that portal, and the session is charged to the merchant's interview credits on completion, not to the learner's coaching credits; it cannot start while the merchant has none.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

max_duration.description: Maximum conversation duration in seconds. Defaults to 1200 (20 min) when omitted.

merchant_id.description: Merchant id. Admin / sub-merchant callers only; otherwise taken from your token.

mojito_language_code.description: Platform language code used for the conversation.

opening_line.description: The avatar's opening line — the FIRST thing it says out loud when the session starts, before the candidate has said anything. If omitted, the platform inserts a generic default ("Hello"), a neutral greeting.

persona_avatar_end_conditions.description: When the avatar should end the session.

persona_avatar_knowledge.description: Private facts the avatar can use (numbers, dates, names, objections), plus any personal details shareable only after progress and only if natural — timing written inline, not as labelled subsections. Those personal details are never required for the goal.

persona_avatar_progress.description: How the conversation moves forward — one plain-text value starting with `Mode: turning point` (resistance) or `Mode: steps` (difficult conversation protocol), then the labelled lines for that mode (Initial hold / Unlocks when / … or Framework / Steps / …), including a Gates line stating that later personal details from persona_avatar_knowledge are shared only once progress is earned.

persona_avatar_who_is.description: Who the avatar represents: name, role, context, personality, woven with what drives them underneath (motive, fear, what they refuse until heard, what they do not know until told).

persona_role_avatar.description: The role the AI avatar plays.

portal.description: Left out, it is `coaching`. Values: `interview`: a scored role-play a recruiter invites candidates to, billed to merchant credits, attempts capped | `coaching`: a practice persona learners start from the catalogue, paid from their own coaching minutes, never visible to recruiters.

recording.description: Cheating/proctoring detection mode for candidate answers — this is NOT a full session recording. Omit, null or `none` to disable. Values: `audio_first_5_answers`: Audio-only cheating detection, first 5 answers only | `audio_all`: Audio-only cheating detection on every answer | `video_all`: Audio + video cheating detection on every answer | `video_first_5_answers`: Audio + video cheating detection, first 5 answers only | `none`: No cheating detection.

recording_full_session.description: Full interview-session recording (includes the avatar and voice) produced as a single file. Omit, null or `none` to disable. Values: `audio_all`: Record the whole session audio | `video_all`: Record the whole session video + audio | `none`: No full-session recording.

recruiter_profile_id.description: Profile id of the recruiter owning this persona. A user of the company who is not read only: an owner, recruiter or admin from list_users.

result_view.description: Result screen shown to the candidate after finishing. With any value other than `none`, the candidate sees a results screen where they can provide feedback, record an intro video and edit the transcript, and must then submit the result; the value sets how much score/result detail is shown. Values: `none`: No results screen at all | `minimal`: Minimal results layout, no score shown | `minimal_with_score`: Minimal results layout including the overall score | `advanced`: Advanced results layout with more detail | `full`: Full results layout with all sections | `full_expand_scores`: Full results with every score breakdown expanded.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the interview. Values: `draft`: Created but not published | `active`: candidates can run it.

tags.description: Free-form tags stored on the persona. Only `active` sessions with visibility `merchant_public` (or the platform's own `public`) are listed.

thank_you_message.description: Custom thank-you message shown after the session; omitting it leaves a generic platform default.

visibility.description: Who can discover and access the interview. Values: `merchant_public`: Listed on the merchant's public interview list | `merchant_invite`: only candidates explicitly invited | `merchant_unlisted`: Reachable only via a direct link.

welcome_message.description: Custom welcome message spoken to the candidate before the role-play starts; omitting it leaves a generic platform default.
